description: Screen counterparty addresses before sending, approving, or interacting: OFAC sanctions, known scam/phishing wallets, labeled protocol contracts, and brand-new-address detection. 1-100 EVM or Solana addresses per call; returns block / caution / no_known_issues per address. Free over MCP for 10 calls per day; beyond that the tool returns the pay-per-call x402 endpoint and its price.
name: address_check
